journey.name: Kicks: sigil-less launch
journey.description:
A fresh install must reach the match lobby with every entry point present, before any sigil exists, with the SDK's wallet pill mounted and no lock trapping the session.
Kicks is the hardest consumer to regress quietly: it is dual-process, it backgrounds its main process for an entire match while gameplay runs elsewhere, and SessionLock deliberately does not arm a background wipe because of it. That makes it the app where a lock-policy change is most likely to do damage and least likely to be noticed — so the no-lock assertions here are load-bearing, not boilerplate.
